newsitem.title: USA: Sears says November sales "on plan".
newsitem.headline: Sears says November sales "on plan".

text.p: Sears, Roebuck and Co said on Thursday that sales were "on plan" for November and that record sales over Thanksgiving weekend gave an "enouraging" start to a strong holiday season.

"Sales were on plan for November given the fact that Thanksgiving was later this year," said Sears chairman and chief executive officer Arthur Martinez said in a statement accompanying sales figures. "Record sales over Thanksgiving weekend produced an encouraging jump-start for a strong holiday shopping season at Sears."

Sears said on Thursday that same-store sales fell 0.7 percent for the four-week period ended November 30 and revenues rose 4.4 percent to $2.68 billion from $2.57 billion in the year-ago period that ended December 2. ((--Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787))
